use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math
use Circle = (x: double, y: double, radius: double)

tangent_to(
    first: Circle, second: Circle, third: Circle,
    outside_first: double, outside_second: double,
    outside_third: double
) -> Circle =>
    (let v11 = 2.0D * second.x - 2.0D * first.x
     let v12 = 2.0D * second.y - 2.0D * first.y
     let v13 =
         first.x * first.x - second.x * second.x +
         first.y * first.y - second.y * second.y -
         first.radius * first.radius + second.radius * second.radius
     let v14 =
         2.0D * outside_second * second.radius -
         2.0D * outside_first * first.radius

     let v21 = 2.0D * third.x - 2.0D * second.x
     let v22 = 2.0D * third.y - 2.0D * second.y
     let v23 =
         second.x * second.x - third.x * third.x +
         second.y * second.y - third.y * third.y -
         second.radius * second.radius + third.radius * third.radius
     let v24 =
         2.0D * outside_third * third.radius -
         2.0D * outside_second * second.radius

     let w12 = v12 / v11
     let w13 = v13 / v11
     let w14 = v14 / v11

     let w22 = v22 / v21 - w12
     let w23 = v23 / v21 - w13
     let w24 = v24 / v21 - w14

     let p = -w23 / w22
     let q = w24 / w22
     let m = -w12 * p - w13
     let n = w14 - w12 * q

     let a = n * n + q * q - 1.0D
     let b =
         2.0D * m * n - 2.0D * n * first.x +
         2.0D * p * q - 2.0D * q * first.y +
         2.0D * outside_first * first.radius
     let c =
         first.x * first.x + m * m - 2.0D * m * first.x +
         p * p + first.y * first.y - 2.0D * p * first.y -
         first.radius * first.radius

     let radius = (-b - Math.sqrt(b * b - 4.0D * a * c)) / (2.0D * a)

     (x = m + n * radius, y = p + q * radius, radius = radius))

let given =
    [(x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D, radius = 1.0D),
     (x = 4.0D, y = 0.0D, radius = 1.0D),
     (x = 2.0D, y = 4.0D, radius = 2.0D)]

let inside =
    tangent_to(given[0], given[1], given[2], 1.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D)

let outside =
    tangent_to(given[0], given[1], given[2], -1.0D, -1.0D, -1.0D)

spelled(circle: Circle) -> string =>
    "x = {circle.x:F6}, y = {circle.y:F6}, "
    "r = {circle.radius:F6}"

for circle in given do
    write_line("given       {spelled(circle)}")
od

write_line("internally  {spelled(inside)}")
write_line("externally  {spelled(outside)}")

let image = IMAGE(600, 600)

image.view(-2.3D, -2.3D, 6.3D, 6.3D)

image.stroke(2.0D)

image.colour(40ub, 40ub, 48ub)

for circle in given do
    image.circle(circle.x, circle.y, circle.radius)
od

image.colour(200ub, 50ub, 50ub)
image.circle(inside.x, inside.y, inside.radius)

image.colour(40ub, 150ub, 70ub)
image.circle(outside.x, outside.y, outside.radius)

image.write("apollonius.png")

image.show("apollonius.png")

         first.radius * first.radius + second.radius * second.radius
     let v14 =
         2.0D * outside_second * second.radius -
         2.0D * outside_first * first.radius

     let v21 = 2.0D * third.x - 2.0D * second.x
     let v22 = 2.0D * third.y - 2.0D * second.y
     let v23 =
         second.x * second.x - third.x * third.x +
         second.y * second.y - third.y * third.y -
         second.radius * second.radius + third.radius * third.radius
     let v24 =
         2.0D * outside_third * third.radius -
         2.0D * outside_second * second.radius

     let w12 = v12 / v11
     let w13 = v13 / v11
     let w14 = v14 / v11

     let w22 = v22 / v21 - w12
     let w23 = v23 / v21 - w13
     let w24 = v24 / v21 - w14

     let p = -w23 / w22
